map.Wh=12×100=1200 Wh=1.2 kWh。若负载平均 50 W，理想续: Wh=12×100=1200 Wh=1.2 kWh. With an average load of 50 W, the ideal runtime ≈1200/50=24 h (excluding efficiency and depth of discharge). Tip: for lithium batteries a depth of discharge within 80% is recommended to extend life.
map.Ah 和 Wh 哪个更能代表容量？: Which better represents capacity, Ah or Wh?
map.Wh 是能量、跨电压可比；Ah 只表征电荷，不同电压不可直接比。选型与续航用 W: Wh is energy and comparable across voltages; Ah only represents charge and cannot be compared directly at different voltages. For selection and runtime, Wh is more accurate.
map.航空携带为什么看 Wh？: Why do airlines look at Wh?
map.民航按电芯 Wh 限制携带（通常≤100 Wh 随身、100–160 Wh 需批: Civil aviation limits carriage by cell Wh (usually ≤100 Wh carry-on, 100-160 Wh requires approval), because Wh directly reflects the energy and safety risk.
